answer: One mechanism: meter reputation through a per-wallet vesting bridge. Each identity's stake crosses epochs through one bridge admitting a fixed K POA per epoch; only vested stake buys influence. The meter counts the funding wallet, not the clone: an orchard of sybils fed from one purse shares a single meter, so N clones mature N times slower, not N times stronger. The river of trust cannot be split into parallel channels - attackers pay in locked capital and elapsed time, and any caught clone forfeits all unvested stake.
